description: Fetch a consolidated metrics snapshot for a single stock by ticker: identity (company, exchange, currency, sector, industry, country, ISIN), latest daily price (OHLCV), latest valuation (market cap, P/E, dividend yield, annual dividend per share), the most recent reported financials (revenue, gross/operating income, EBITDA, net income, diluted EPS, free & operating cash flow, total debt, cash, total assets, equity) and a short company description. Use the exact ticker as listed on Bullrun - the native local-exchange symbol (e.g. AAPL, BMW, ABBN, NESN, or a numeric code like 005930), NOT Yahoo-style country suffixes like BMW.DE or ABBN.SW. If a ticker returns no data, use screen_stocks (by sector/country) to find the exact symbol. Read-only. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

ticker.description: The stock ticker exactly as listed on Bullrun - the native local-exchange symbol, e.g. "AAPL", "BMW" (not "BMW.DE"), "ABBN" (not "ABBN.SW"), "NESN", or a numeric code like "005930". Do not append Yahoo-style country suffixes.
